stepTitle: What is the precision of the model on this data? Leave your answer as a fraction.
stepBody:
To evaluate your logistic regression model, you test it on $$6$$ new students and compare predicted versus true preferences. For each student the predicted value $$\hat{Y}$$ and the true value $$Y$$ are:
• Student 1: predicted $$1$$, true $$1$$
• Student 2: predicted $$1$$, true $$0$$
• Student 3: predicted $$1$$, true $$1$$
• Student 4: predicted $$0$$, true $$0$$
• Student 5: predicted $$0$$, true $$1$$
• Student 6: predicted $$0$$, true $$0$$
As a reminder, $$1$$ indicates a preference for Kendrick, and $$0$$ indicates a preference for Drake.
